stories.h: Nightly SR 167 and SR 512 closures near Puyallup
stories.s: WSDOT is closing single lanes on SR 167, SR 512 and N. Meridian nightly this week. Full closures of SR 167/SR 512 ramps with detours follow Thursday through Saturday night.

stories.h: Tree-harvesting helicopter crashes in Orting-area parking lot
stories.s: A logging helicopter made a hard landing Saturday morning on McCutcheon Road East after a possible engine failure. The pilot was hospitalized with non-life-threatening injuries, and the FAA and NTSB are investigating.

coming.h: Veterans Day: Pierce Transit on weekday schedule
coming.s: Pierce Transit runs its regular weekday schedule on Veterans Day. Veterans Day is a state legal holiday, so many government offices will be closed.
SR 167/SR 512 interchange ramps close fully overnight Thursday through Saturday, and drivers will be detoured.

coming.h: Stronger wind and rain system arrives Friday
coming.s: Forecasters expect a stronger storm Friday into the weekend, bringing more wind, rain and high-elevation snow. Strong winds could reach the Puget Sound interior.
